name: Shirley Corvette
original_name: シャーリー・コルベット
source:
A character who will surpassed Aoi in terms of Agility, but with less damage. Her skill have a lot of AOE, making her become a finisher. Her attack type is Fire.

A transfer student in Agaresta Academy, class 2-C, and known as "Ice Queen", due to her silent endeavor. She's born in a family who specialized in sports, thus making her able to do almost any sports. Shirley often called by other sports member when they need her help.

Her weapon is dual gun, with one is "beretta" type, the other are "shotgun" type.
